entities.title: Library source
entities.summary: The utv crate's code: the JSON layer (validation, builders, ISO 8601, the text form, operations, zone rules) and, in child folders, the typed layer and the native adapters.
entities.purpose: lib.rs is the crate root: it holds the result types (UtvResult, Status, Diagnostic), strict JSON parsing, envelope and structural-schema validation and the Gregorian check, declares the public modules build, iso, text, ops, zones and interop and the private model, num and typed, and re-exports both layers at the crate root. model.rs reads UTV JSON into checked records and writes canonical shapes; num.rs is the exact arithmetic everything else uses.
boundaries: Takes UTV JSON as serde_json::Value and answers UtvResult; the typed types live in typed/, the native conversions in interop/.
Holds no rule data: zone rules come from the caller through Rules::load, Rules::parse or Rules::from_json.
The structural schema is compiled in from schema/utv-1.0.schema.json at the repository root (include_str!), not copied.
